title: Sudoku
description: Fill the 9×9 grid so every row, column and box holds the digits 1 to 9 in this clean, free Sudoku puzzle you play in your browser.
about:
Sudoku is the classic number logic puzzle, here in a clean and distraction-free version. Every game deals a fresh 9×9 board with 30 given digits, and your job is to fill the remaining 51 cells so that each row, each column and each 3×3 box contains the numbers 1 to 9 exactly once.

Tap a cell to open the number pad and pick a digit. The board highlights the row, column and box of the selected cell and shows matching numbers in blue, while a digit that clashes with another one turns red straight away. Pencil mode lets you jot up to four candidate numbers in a cell before you commit, and a counter tracks filled cells and elapsed seconds.

It is a relaxing way to train your logic for a few minutes, whether you are new to Sudoku or solve one every morning.
howToPlay: Select an empty cell and choose a number from the pad that appears. Each row, column and 3×3 box must contain the digits 1 to 9 with no repeats; conflicting numbers are shown in red. Fill all 81 cells without conflicts to complete the puzzle.

controls.action: Select a cell and open the number pad
Place a number in the selected cell

tips: Start with rows, columns or boxes that already have many digits: the missing ones are easier to find.
Watch the blue highlights after selecting a cell to see where a number already appears.
Use pencil mode to note two or three candidates in tricky cells instead of guessing.
A red cell means the number clashes with another one in its row, column or box, so fix it before moving on.

faq.question: Is Sudoku free to play?
faq.answer: Yes. Sudoku is completely free and runs in your browser, with no download or sign-up.

faq.question: Can I play Sudoku on my phone or tablet?
faq.answer: Yes. The board scales to fit the screen and you play entirely by tapping cells and the on-screen number pad.

faq.question: Do I get a new puzzle every time?
faq.answer: Yes. Each game generates a new board with 30 starting digits, and the Play Again button deals a fresh one when you finish.
